title: Target
description: What a rule, category assignment or unlock applies to: an app, a site (domain plus optional path glob) or a surface.

appPackage.title: AppPackage
appPackage.description: Android package name or macOS bundle id (reverse DNS).

domain.title: Domain
domain.description: Lower-case ASCII (punycode) host without scheme or port. Matches itself and its subdomains. Rule domains are normalised like URL hosts before matching (`www.`/`m.` dropped, aliases rewritten), so `twitter.com` or `m.youtube.com` are accepted.

pathGlob.title: PathGlob
pathGlob.description: Path glob starting with `/`. Segments are literals, `*` (exactly one segment) or a final `**` (zero or more segments). No partial wildcards, no regex.

surfaceId.title: SurfaceId
surfaceId.description: Surface id `<family>.<name>` from data/surfaces.json, for example `youtube.shorts`.
